name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $90.8 on 27 Nov, 21% lower over a month; Hormuz tanker attacks continue
state: Brent settled near $90.8 on 27 Nov, 1.9% lower on the week and 21% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Vortexa data cited by Bloomberg on 26 Nov show tanker transits of Hormuz above 26 a day on a seven-day average through 19 Nov, up from October, even as Iran intensified attacks on ships (gCaptain). No new outage above 2 mb/d is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Fuel and transport costs remain exposed to Gulf disruption, though oil prices have fallen from their October highs.

sources.title: gCaptain — Hormuz tanker traffic rises this month even as attacks increase

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
